courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
related.titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
related.transfer: 可遷移「地層支護曲線交點」與「收斂曲線與外推界線」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ground-support curve intersection" and "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋；敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐則以敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation; Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs centres on exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock TBMs, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地層支護曲線交點」與「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「超挖體積與出碴核對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ground-support curve intersection” and “Crown blocks and self-weight path”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道台階法施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「地層支護曲線交點」與「收斂曲線與外推界線」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道台階法施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ground-support curve intersection" and "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bench excavation for tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋；隧道台階法施工則以台階開挖的拱腳承載、核心保留與仰拱閉合時序為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation; Bench excavation for tunnels centres on bench excavation, arch-foot bearing, retained core and invert-closure timing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地層支護曲線交點」與「上半斷面與反力位置」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道台階法施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「閉合追趕與相對速度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ground-support curve intersection” and “Upper section and reaction locations”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bench excavation for tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Closure catch-up and relative speed", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
history.text: Crossrail的公開論文把噴凝土襯砌與地層互制及施工序列放在同一設計問題中，並回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗隧道的軟土地下施工。二〇〇九年FHWA土建手冊提供另一套工程背景，二〇一四年公開的Stepney Green論文呈現側導坑序列與量測比較。這些文獻並不支持把某個縮短步距或增加厚度當成萬用解法；本課追蹤的是每一次邊界改變如何影響可觀測的力流。
history.textEn: Crossrail authors treat sprayed lining, ground interaction and construction sequence as one design problem, and discuss the 1992 Heathrow Express soft-ground trial tunnel. The 2009 FHWA civil manual provides another engineering reference, while the 2014 Stepney Green paper presents side-drift sequencing with monitoring comparisons. None makes a shorter advance or thicker lining a universal solution. This course instead follows how each changed boundary alters the load path and the observations needed to test it.

history.textEn: The course turns "Ground-support curve intersection" through "Layered-lining handover and defect map" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
